summary:

All prior scope entries, risk/permission/side-effect/verification facts, original base 1f748a99b97842b9eca7abf4be454d348bf78759, identity, branch and forbidden actions remain unchanged. The current strict state is WAITING_FOR_SPEC_REVIEW, with fresh REVIEW/V2 classification. The unchanged Git/LF Node CI Norm SHA is 196c46ac77e16ab8254f4f210796353bd44058153eeda5947931bec285fb9162.

The prerequisite's production delta is the narrow O_BINARY append flag in the existing task_service.py writer; its regression and complete history are transported through an ordinary merge, not reauthored by TASK-0138. I inspected TASK-0139 final-phase passed evidence and its existing design/implementation review records as retained prerequisite history. Its prior approvals and originals retain their original worktree/binding meaning and are not asserted as current TASK-0138 proof. The merged prerequisite prevents Windows text translation of already encoded UTF-8/LF event suffixes while preserving prior LF/CRLF prefix bytes and existing write/fsync/error/close behavior. This is directly necessary for exact retained event bytes and strict whitespace, rather than an unrelated architectural change.

The amendment preserves all previous native, Node1 and local3.2 contracts, complete current-source native V2 verification, 85/90 thresholds, full original-base diff, fixed process/output/material/role budgets, all five mutation obligations and independent current-snapshot/final/code/Gate requirements. CI capacities remain unregistered. Fresh finite physical-kernel measurement, independent concrete cap registration review and subsequent Norm/spec rebinding remain mandatory; this design review certifies neither a measurement nor an implementation result. Exact-head PR #149 required CI remains a separate prerequisite before publication; no remote result is inferred from local proof.

The existing scope-edit precedent is limited to proposing the two explicit scope fields; the actual synchronization, resolution, recovery classification and freezing are represented by the current CLI-derived facts. No source approval, human identity, remote association, imported Current or target authority is manufactured. Pending A04, public-source material permission, target declaration, authorized private CI/transfer, native/model/SDK/WeChat restrictions and original-host combined Gate remain unchanged. APPROVE is DESIGN only, with no findings. I authored none of the dependency implementation. Only the formal immutable design context/review, its appended review_recorded event and necessary task timestamp are written; no spec/action/code approval, state advance, kernel, suite, network call, publication or target write is performed.
